description: This source file defines a GUI application for creating and editing modifier maps in the BORIS behavioral observation software. It includes classes for the main window and custom graphics view, methods for loading/saving maps, drawing polygons, and managing modifiers.

classes.name: ModifiersMapCreatorWindow
classes.description: Main window class for creating and editing modifier maps, including UI components and map management methods.

classes.name: ModifiersMapCreatorWindow.View
classes.description: Custom QGraphicsView subclass handling mouse press events for polygon drawing.

methods.name: area_list_item_click
methods.description: Handles selection of a modifier polygon from the list.

methods.name: get_current_alpha_value
methods.description: Returns the current opacity value from the color button text.

methods.name: slAlpha_changed
methods.description: Updates the opacity of the selected polygon based on slider value.

methods.name: chooseColor
methods.description: Opens a color dialog to select the area color.

methods.name: closeEvent
methods.description: Handles window close event, prompting to save if there are unsaved changes.

methods.name: viewMousePressEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse press events for drawing polygons, selecting areas, and editing.

methods.name: mapName_clicked
methods.description: Prompts user to change the map name.

methods.name: newMap
methods.description: Creates a new modifier map, prompting to save current if needed.

methods.name: openMap
methods.description: Loads a map from a file and displays it.

methods.name: saveMap
methods.description: Saves the current map to a file.

methods.name: saveAsMap_clicked
methods.description: Saves the map under a new filename.

methods.name: saveMap_clicked
methods.description: Handles save action, prompting for filename if necessary.

methods.name: newArea
methods.description: Starts the process to create a new modifier polygon.

methods.name: saveArea
methods.description: Saves the new or modified modifier polygon.

methods.name: update_area_list
methods.description: Updates the list widget with current modifiers.

methods.name: cancelMap
methods.description: Clears the current map and resets state.

methods.name: loadBitmap
methods.description: Loads a background bitmap for the map.
